title.narrative: Colombia National Energy Communities Program - Mitigation Action Facility

description.narrative: The proposed intervention delivers demand-led technical assistance to the Ministry of Mines and Energy of Colombia (MME), Energy and Gas Regulation Commission (CREG), Superintendency of Residential Public Services (SSPD), and communities to implement the National Energy Communities Model referred in the new National Development Plan 2022-2026 to increase the sustainability of the Colombian energy generation system by making citizens and communities drivers of the low-carbon energy transition. The intervention will lead to the rollout of 10 renewable energy community projects, and it is estimated that it can accomplish the deployment of 10MW of renewable energy capacity, creating 300 green jobs and avoiding the emission of 500tCO2eq.
